conditions.name: Market Structure Alignment
conditions.description: Price is aligned with clear higher timeframe or current 5M market structure (higher highs/lows for BUY, lower highs/lows for SELL).

conditions.name: Key Level / Liquidity Sweep
conditions.description: Price has swept recent liquidity (equal highs/lows) or tested a key support/resistance or supply/demand zone.

conditions.name: Trigger Candle Rejection / Engulfing
conditions.description: Current 5M candle shows strong directional rejection (wick) or momentum engulfing in the expected trade direction.

conditions.name: Clear Room to Target
conditions.description: Clean path to 2:1 Take Profit without an immediate opposing structure obstacle blocking the move.
